Adding documentation to the API will explain how to interact with the minimum(number1, number2) function. Providing examples to demonstrate the functions usage will clearly show how to use the function. For example, API documentation is:

The minimum(number1, number2) method returns the integer with the minimum value of the two arguments. The first argument, number1, is the first number to be compared. The second argument, number2, is the second number in the comparison. minimum(3, 4) will return 3, and minimum(2, 5) will return 2. This method accepts integers only.

Adding documentation to the API will explain how to interact with the substring(start, end) function. Providing examples to demonstrate the functions usage will clearly show how to use the function. For example, API documentation is:
